claims.text: Alibaba Model Studio recorded Qwen3-Coder on July 22 as a Qwen3-based code model with agent/tool-calling and environment-interaction capabilities.
The lifecycle page shows continued H2 expansion across long-context/reasoning, coder, vision/omni, speech, and image-generation model families rather than a single-model cadence.
Availability entries distinguish regions and dated snapshots, so model identity and deployment availability must remain separate from upstream/open-weight announcements.

limitations.text: The Model Studio page is a living deployment catalog; it mixes release, snapshot, regional availability, and later global availability entries. Architecture must not collapse those into one upstream model release date.
